Maslow's Hierarchy of Needs arranges human needs in a pyramid, from basic to higher-level needs.  
Physiological needs are the most basic (food, water).  
Social needs involve belonging and relationships.  
Esteem needs relate to respect and recognition.  
Self-actualization, at the top, refers to realizing personal potential and fulfillment.  
The description in the question matches self-actualization.
